figurative_meaning_en: To stage a sit-in protest or feign illness by lying down to achieve a goal
similar_in_english: Throw oneself on the floor in protest
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার চাহিদা পূরণের জন্য আদা জল খেয়ে পড়ে থাকল।
বাচ্চারা খেলতে না পারলে আদা জল খেয়ে পড়ে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He lay down drinking ginger water to protest until his demand was met.
The children would drink ginger water and lie down when they couldn't play.
note: This idiom reflects a cultural practice of non-violent protest or persuasion through symbolic inaction, often in rural or semi-urban Bengali settings.
